title: Maximum residue levels for pinoxaden
summary: EU proposes to increase MRL for pinoxaden on barley, rye, and wheat
update: The European Union (EU) proposes to increase the maximum residue level (MRL) for pinoxaden on barley, rye, and wheat from 0.7 to 0.8 mg/kg.
what_changing: The EU proposes to increase the MRL for pinoxaden on barley, rye, and wheat from 0.7 to 0.8 mg/kg.
why: Following an application for a change of MRL by the producer of pinoxaden, the European Food Safety Authority evaluated the requested change and concluded that increasing the MRL would not pose a risk for consumers ( EFSA 2025 ).
timeline: The Regulation is expected to be published in October 2026, and will apply 6 months after publication.
background: MRLs are set in accordance with the rules set out in Regulation 396/2005 . For information on current MRLs for other substances, please consult the EU Pesticide Residues database . For further information on the setting of import tolerances, see Pesticide residue import tolerance MRLs explained .
resources: EFSA (2025) Modification of the existing maximum residue levels in barley, wheat and rye, and evaluation of Art.12 confirmatory for pinoxaden . EFSA Journal, 23(11): e9742.
